description: Screen a person or company against the OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU, UK, Canadian, Swiss and Australian sanctions lists and the US Consolidated Screening List (BIS Entity List, Denied Persons, State Department debarments, OFAC non-SDN lists; refreshed daily). Fuzzy match including aliases and word order. Each hit returns the listed name, score, record ID, sanctions programmes, aliases, and a comparison of the date of birth, nationality and type you pass against the listed record, which helps rule out namesakes. Pass dob and country whenever you know them. Costs $0.02.
